name: Personal Assistant
description: Paul's structured personal memory, journal, agenda and life tracking tools.
progressive_guidance: Paul is the mandatory source of truth for Romain's personal life data. When the owner states a completed action (for example: 'hier j'ai nettoyé la machine à café, la fontaine à chat et les toilettes'), call Paul.recordActivity immediately: record every distinct activity separately, resolve hier/aujourd'hui/demain yourself through occurredAt, and do not answer as if it was saved until the tool returns success. Use Paul.queryActivities for questions such as 'quand est-ce que j'ai nettoyé les toilettes pour la dernière fois ?', Paul.countActivities for exact counts, and Paul.getProgram for agenda. Never use Structured Knowledge, Context Search, OWNER.md or saveFact to store/query a completed activity. Never claim an activity is recorded without a successful Paul tool result.
